description: Utah validation addresses — v2026.5.0. Assertions match Phase 133 SHIPPED coverage, not idealized. Known gaps (backlogged counties, un-imported city councils) are encoded as {exact:0} — these are EXPECTED PASS outcomes per D-08. No federal tier: UT Congressional members not yet in PIP join path.

addresses.label: SLC Capitol — 451 S State St
addresses.notes: Full-stack capital: state legis, SBOE, county, city council+mayor, school. Phase 133 verified 62 officials. No federal (UT Congress not in PIP path).

addresses.label: Fort Duchesne (Uintah & Ouray Reservation)
addresses.notes: Tribal-land case — on Uintah and Ouray Reservation. Uintah County is backlogged (no county/city officials imported). X0004 auxiliary query confirms tribal coverage. Phase 133 verified tribal_land.on_reservation=true.

addresses.label: Provo City Hall — 445 W Center St
addresses.notes: Provo city council wards imported Phase 133 (ArcGIS FeatureServer). city:2 = council member + mayor. Utah County commissioners present.

addresses.label: Park City — 445 Marsac Ave
addresses.notes: Park City city council NOT imported (no ArcGIS source found Phase 133) — city:0 is PASS (D-08). Summit County commissioners and Park City SD present.

addresses.label: Antelope Island (Davis County — unincorporated)
addresses.notes: Confirmed unincorporated: no LOCAL/LOCAL_EXEC polygon. Davis County G4020 only. No city tier expected — definitive unincorporated test case (Antelope Island chosen over Emigration Canyon which has a LOCAL council district).

addresses.label: Magna — 2510 S 8400 W, Magna UT
addresses.notes: Magna metro-township (HB 356) — its own council imported Phase 131. city:1 = Magna council rep. Salt Lake County (15 officials).

addresses.label: Fillmore (Millard County — gap city)
addresses.notes: county:0 and city:0 are EXPECTED PASS outcome (D-08). Millard County is a backlogged tail county (19 unimported). Fillmore is the county seat but its council was not imported. state_board:1 from SBOE sub-district.

addresses.label: Temple Square — 50 W North Temple, SLC
addresses.notes: Within SLC boundaries — same SBOE District 6, same SLC council coverage as SLC Capitol (address #1). Confirms SLC polygon covers tourist/religious landmark area.

addresses.label: East Millcreek (Salt Lake County — SBOE District 6)
addresses.notes: Exercises classify_tier() STATE_BOARD branch (Pitfall 4). SBOE District 6 (Carol Lear) confirmed by geofence query. city:1 = Salt Lake County Council D4 rep (LOCAL district_type maps to city tier).

addresses.label: Richmond (Cache County — small town)
addresses.notes: Cache County is one of 10 covered counties (Phase 133). county:25 = large Cache County commission roster. Richmond City Council NOT imported — city:0 is PASS (D-08). Cache County SD imported (7 board members).
